recognize_zh: 周邊血中成群的中型淋巴細胞，核圓至卵圓、略偏心，染色質均勻細緻、無明顯核仁，胞質淡藍灰且邊緣有細長毛狀突起，是典型的毛細胞（hairy cells）。
features: Medium-sized lymphoid cells, 1.5–2 times the size of small lymphocytes, with moderate N:C ratio
Round to oval or slightly indented nuclei, often eccentric
Homogeneous, finely stippled (ground-glass) chromatin without prominent nucleoli
Moderate pale gray-blue cytoplasm with circumferential fine hair-like projections
Background red cells unremarkable; no granules or vacuoles in the lymphoid cells
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a cluster of medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells with round to oval, somewhat eccentric nuclei, homogeneous finely dispersed chromatin, and absent or inconspicuous nucleoli. The cells have moderate amounts of pale gray-blue cytoplasm with irregular, circumferential hair-like cytoplasmic projections. Background red cells show no significant abnormality. Findings are consistent with hairy cell leukemia; confirmation by flow cytometry (CD11c, CD25, CD103, CD123) and BRAF V600E testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: HCL-v cells have a distinct central nucleolus and are CD25- and annexin A1-negative with wild-type BRAF.

ddx.dx: Splenic marginal zone lymphoma with villous lymphocytes
ddx.vs: SMZL cells have short polar villi, more condensed chromatin and lack the CD103/CD25/CD11c triad.
LGLs have azurophilic granules and a T/NK phenotype, and reactive lymphocytes show cytoplasm hugging red cells without fine projections.
Monocytes have folded nuclei with lacy chromatin, vacuoles and fine granules, and express CD14 rather than B-cell markers.
